title: Ann Arbor Taiwanese Association 安雅堡 台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Ann Arbor Taiwanese Association (AATA) is a community organization serving Taiwanese and Taiwanese American residents primarily in Ann Arbor, Michigan. It is a chapter of the national Taiwanese Association of America (TAA-USA) and falls within the TAA’s Mid-Western regional district. The chapter describes itself as a group that stands for the welfare of Taiwanese and Taiwanese Americans across diverse backgrounds.
